Apple Expected to Launch New Smart Home Hub and Devices

Apple is anticipated to unveil its new smart home hub, reportedly named HomeView, on October 13. Analysts have made predictions regarding the device. While the hub is expected to be announced tomorrow, its shipment is not slated until mid-November. The launch event is also expected to include refreshed versions of the Apple TV and HomePod mini.
